stories.title: Whatever happened to the diamond that went missing in F1 crash?
stories.summary: Whatever happened to the diamond that went missing after the Formula 1 car it was attached to crashed? If you were in Monaco, consider yourself a suspect - or at least a witness - in Formula 1's biggest unsolved mystery. A $300,000 diamond was last seen stuck to the front of an F1 car before it crashed on the first lap of the Grand Prix and it still has not been found 22 years later. Did someone pick it up? Was it swept up with all the debris? Did it slip down a drain? Was it even a real diamond? The reason why a 1.4 carat diamond was attached to the most delicate part of a car that reaches 200mph in a race was straightforward: publicity.
